# Learned instinct: ansible-become-explicit (confidence 0.95)

`become: true` without `become_user:` defaults to root. For PCI-scope systems, `become_user:` must always be explicit. Using `become: true` on tasks that do not require root is a HIGH finding. Prefer module-level privilege over broad play-level become where possible.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 7.2 (restrict access); CIS Benchmark least-privilege
